description: Use this when you need an ordered exploded-view plan for an assembly. Supply parts as {name,center:[x,y,z],size:[x,y,z]} in mm. Optional assembly_order sets the sequence; missing order falls back to input part order, and unlisted/unknown order refs are reported. Choose mode axis (default) or radial; axis follows the requested direction, radial moves parts away from the assembly centroid. The result includes ready-to-paste param_declarations, animation_tracks and reverse_animation_tracks for animationView(), part_transforms for existing shapes, and script_fragment. cameraPlan gives framing guidance.

duration_ms.description: Timeline duration from 500 to 60000 ms; default 3000.

parts.description: Named assembly parts and measured bbox centers/sizes in mm.

name: explode_view
title: Plan Exploded View
